title: Add `--format` to `podman manifest inspect`
body:
### Feature request description

Our other inspect commands allow for a `--format` option to have more control over what is displayed, but it's missing from `podman manifest inspect`

### Suggest potential solution

Add the `--format` flag; implementation can be very similar to the existing `podman inspect` command.

### Have you considered any alternatives?

N/A

### Additional context

N/A
